verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Google Calendar connecting Outlook or Apple calendars, or checking them for conflicts. The API's free/busy query over a set of calendars is a developer building block limited to Google calendars, not the cross-provider conflict-checking this story asks for. A community report also notes the Android app supports no calendar server other than Google's without a separate sync app.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked
